diagnosis: In this gRPC service method exposed to gRPC-Web clients through Envoy, the getInvoicePdf RPC accepts invoice_id from the protobuf request. While Envoy extracts and forwards x-tenant-id in gRPC metadata, the backend method queries MongoDB purely by _id without ensuring that invoice.tenant_id matches x-tenant-id. An attacker issuing gRPC-Web requests can access sensitive billing invoices and tax documents belonging to rival tenants.
